samples_reviewed.question_text: Use base-10 blocks to show the number 203.
Use base-10 blocks to show the number 470.
What number is marked on the number line?
What number is marked on the number line?
What number do the blocks show?
Move the dot to show 717 on the number line.
Move the dot to show 821 on the number line.
What number is marked on the number line?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both verbs are discharged. Recognising is covered by items that read a value off blocks or off a marked line, and representing is covered by items instructing the learner to build a number with base-10 blocks or to move the dot to a given position, so the learner produces the model rather than only interpreting one.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency promises a variety of concrete and pictorial models, yet only two ever appear: base-10 blocks and the number line. Place-value charts, bundled objects, money and expanded notation are all absent, so a variety amounts to a pair, and each of the eight samples is one of four near-identical stems.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Several number-line items ask the learner to choose between four consecutive or near-consecutive three-digit values, such as distinguishing a point at 710 from 709, 711 and 712. Resolving single units at that magnitude on a drawn line is a perceptual task rather than a number-sense one, and it is an unfair demand at Grade 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only two response types occur and each is locked to one model, with reading always done on blocks or a line and producing always done by building or dragging. No item bridges the models by asking which representation matches a given numeral, and no numeral-to-numeral or word-form orientation appears at all.

competency_alignment.rationale: What changes between seeds is which representation the learner must move between and in which direction, which is exactly what this competency is about. The pairing of a build-the-number task with a read-the-number task on the same model is a coherent way to build representational fluency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Values run from just over two hundred up to the low eight-hundreds, all three-digit and all under the stated thousand. That range fits base-10 block work, where hundreds flats remain countable, and matches the Quarter 1 number range.
